name: optimumbd/reseller-platform
description: Domain & Hosting Reseller Platform — runs on shared hosting (PHP 8.1+, MySQL/MariaDB).

suggest.ext-gd: Image processing for avatars and themes
suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: Optional. SMTP mail driver. Falls back to PHP mail() if absent.
suggest.tecnickcom/tcpdf: Optional. PDF invoices. Falls back to HTML if absent.
suggest.robthree/twofactorauth: Optional. Faster TOTP. Built-in implementation works without it.
suggest.endroid/qr-code: Optional. Local QR rendering. Otherwise an external chart URL is used.
